lead: An enum case behind a `mixed` reads *falsy* when its backing integer is `0`; behind its declared type it is truthy.
body: `rule:types/literal-types` spends no representation on hiding the backing value and the runtime table dispatches on the tag, so the erased row diverges from what `rule:enums/truthiness` decided. Do not assert the erased row as if it were the rule's answer.
